metadata.description: Public SanctifAI agent plugins: Trust (participation seal) and Source (hire/ask a human via MCP + REST).

plugins.name: sanctifai-trust
plugins.description: Trust participation seal for chat agents: a human showed up and sealed a payload (WebAuthn). Never who, never correct. Mint attestation → Chrome approve_url → poll certificate_url. Pair with sanctifai-source to hire/ask a human.

plugins.name: sanctifai-source
plugins.description: Hire or ask a human via MCP (https://app.sanctifai.com/mcp) and REST (https://app.sanctifai.com/v1). Self-serve/beta, no staffed SLA. Not identity. Pair with sanctifai-trust for a participation seal.
